delivery.lead-time: Median lead time (commit authored to tag, hours): {value}
delivery.patch-ratio: Patch release ratio (patch tags ÷ all tags): {value}
delivery.caveat: All values are approximations from tags. The patch release ratio is not the change failure rate, and time to restore cannot be known from tags alone.
delivery.not-a-repo: Not a git repository, so no metrics
